I’ll check the Anthropic streaming adapter and its tests, then fix tool-call indexing and finish events. I’m using the repository’s Python style skill for this change.
The adapter uses content-block positions as choice indices, assigns every tool fragment index 0, and repeats the finish chunk for each block. I’ve separated tool-call numbering from block positions and removed that finish loop. I’ll test parallel calls with text before and between them, plus text-only and empty responses.
Fixed Anthropic streaming to number tool calls sequentially from 0 regardless of text blocks, keep all chunks in choice 0, and emit one finish event per response. Non-streaming behavior is unchanged.

Added regression coverage for parallel calls, mixed text/tool blocks, and empty responses. All 74 Anthropic tests passed; pytest’s final reporting hook hit a sandbox permission error. No dependencies installed.

+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "block_types",
+    [
+        ["tool_use", "tool_use"],
+        ["text", "tool_use", "tool_use"],
+        ["tool_use", "text", "tool_use"],
+        ["text", "tool_use"],
+        ["text", "text"],
+        [],
+    ],
+)
+async def test_chat_stream_content_block_indices(block_types):
+    events = [
+        {
+            "type": "message_start",
+            "message": {
+                "id": "test-id",
+                "model": "claude-2.1",
+                "usage": {"input_tokens": 25},
+            },
+        }
+    ]
+    expected_calls = []
+    expected_indices = []
+    for block_index, block_type in enumerate(block_types):
+        if block_type == "tool_use":
+            tool_id = f"toolu_{block_index}"
+            arguments = json.dumps({"location": f"city_{block_index}"})
+            content_block = {
+                "type": "tool_use",
+                "id": tool_id,
+                "name": "get_weather",
+                "input": {},
+            }
+            deltas = [
+                {"type": "input_json_delta", "partial_json": fragment}
+                for fragment in (arguments[:10], arguments[10:])
+            ]
+            expected_indices.extend([len(expected_calls)] * 3)
+            expected_calls.append(
+                {"id": tool_id, "name": "get_weather", "arguments": arguments}
+            )
+        else:
+            content_block = {"type": "text", "text": ""}
+            deltas = [{"type": "text_delta", "text": "Checking the weather."}]
+        events.append(
+            {"type": "content_block_start", "index": block_index, "content_block": content_block}
+        )
+        events.extend(
+            {"type": "content_block_delta", "index": block_index, "delta": delta}
+            for delta in deltas
+        )
+        events.append({"type": "content_block_stop", "index": block_index})
+    events.extend(
+        [
+            {
+                "type": "message_delta",
+                "delta": {"stop_reason": "tool_use" if expected_calls else "end_turn"},
+                "usage": {"output_tokens": 15},
+            },
+            {"type": "message_stop"},
+        ]
+    )
+    resp = [f"data: {json.dumps(event)}\n".encode() for event in events]
+    with mock.patch(
+        "aiohttp.ClientSession.post", return_value=MockAsyncStreamingResponse(resp)
+    ) as mock_post:
+        provider = AnthropicProvider(EndpointConfig(**chat_config()))
+        payload = chat.RequestPayload(**chat_function_calling_payload(stream=True))
+        chunks = [chunk async for chunk in provider.chat_stream(payload)]
+    mock_post.assert_called_once()
+
+    assert all(len(chunk.choices) == 1 and chunk.choices[0].index == 0 for chunk in chunks)
+    assert [chunk.choices[0].finish_reason for chunk in chunks] == [None] * (len(chunks) - 1) + [
+        "stop"
+    ]
+    assert chunks[-1].usage.prompt_tokens == 25
+    assert chunks[-1].usage.completion_tokens == 15
+    assert chunks[-1].usage.total_tokens == 40
+    assert all(chunk.usage is None for chunk in chunks[:-1])
+    assert "".join(chunk.choices[0].delta.content or "" for chunk in chunks) == (
+        "Checking the weather." * block_types.count("text")
+    )
+
+    tool_deltas = [tool for chunk in chunks for tool in chunk.choices[0].delta.tool_calls or []]
+    assert [tool.index for tool in tool_deltas] == expected_indices
+    calls = {}

+        calls[tool.index]["arguments"] += tool.function.arguments or ""
